# OtlpDashboard

> OtlpDashboard (also called OpenTelemetry Dashboard) is an open-source, self-hosted OTLP receiver and viewer for OpenTelemetry traces, logs and metrics. It runs as a single Docker container, stores telemetry in SQLite, PostgreSQL or SQL Server, and includes custom dashboards and a read-only MCP server for AI assistants. Licence: GPL-3.0.

It sits between the .NET Aspire dashboard (in-memory, no custom dashboards) and a full Grafana, Tempo, Loki and Prometheus stack (many services to run). It is a good fit for development teams, side projects and small to medium production workloads that want persistent telemetry without operating an observability platform. It has no alerting.

Key facts:

- Ingestion: OTLP over gRPC on port 4317 and OTLP over HTTP/Protobuf on port 4318. The web app is served on port 4318 too.
- Signals: traces (span tree and flame view), logs (linked to traces), metrics (grouped by service and instance), and a service map built from spans.
- Storage: SQLite by default; PostgreSQL or SQL Server via `Dashboard__Storage__Provider`.
- Retention: per signal, in days (defaults: logs 30, traces 7, metrics 7), enforced by a background sweep.
- Auth: two optional bearer tokens, `DASHBOARD__BROWSERTOKEN` for the web app, API and MCP, and `DASHBOARD__OTLP__APIKEY` for ingestion.
- Dashboards: widgets on a 12-column grid (stat, line, sparkline, gauge, bar gauge, pie, heatmap, recent traces, top traces, logs stream, text), user-saved widgets, and packs of widgets and dashboards installed from Git.
- MCP: set `Dashboard__Mcp__Enabled=true` to mount a Model Context Protocol server at `/mcp` with tools `query_logs`, `query_traces`, `get_trace`, `list_metrics`, `query_metric_points` and others.
- Stack: .NET 10 and EF Core backend, Nuxt 4 / Vue 3 single-page app.

Quick start:

```bash
docker run -d --name otlp-dashboard -p 4317:4317 -p 4318:4318 -v otlp-data:/app/data ghcr.io/adiakys/otlpdashboard:latest
export OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:4317
```

Then open http://localhost:4318. With Docker Compose:

```yaml
services:
  otlp-dashboard:
    image: ghcr.io/adiakys/otlpdashboard:latest
    ports:
      - "4317:4317"
      - "4318:4318"
    volumes:
      - otlp-data:/app/data
    restart: unless-stopped
volumes:
  otlp-data:
```

Other services in the same Compose project send telemetry to `http://otlp-dashboard:4317`.
